subject: Kestrel: access variance and required artifacts
messages:
From: Alex Warren <alex.warren@kestrelhealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: security@kestrelhealth.com
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kestrel: noticed account-owner variance — need SCIM/SAML artifacts

Hi Hannah,

We ran our quarterly access validation and our tooling flagged ~18 accounts in your tenant whose role changed from "developer" to "admin" between 2027-05-30 and 2027-06-02. We need the following artifacts to complete our audit: a SCIM delta for that window, SAML assertion logs for affected users, and the RBAC mapping that shows what "admin" entails in Redwood.

Can you confirm you can provide CSV logs (SCIM delta + timestamps), the raw SAML assertion export, and a short justification for any elevated privileges during that period? Our compliance deadline for this quarter is next week (2027-06-25).

Thanks,
Alex Warren
Security Lead — Kestrel Health
alex.warren@kestrelhealth.com
--
Attachment: (none in original)
From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
To: Alex Warren <alex.warren@kestrelhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kestrel: noticed account-owner variance — need SCIM/SAML artifacts

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads-up. We can absolutely assemble the artifacts you requested. High level plan:

- Laura will pull the SCIM delta export for 2027-05-30 to 2027-06-02 and redact any PII as needed.
- Rishi will prepare the SAML assertion bundle and a short note explaining session context for elevated sign-ins (IP, MFA status).
- I will attach the current RBAC matrix and a short justification for each user where privileges increased.

Can you confirm the list of affected user IDs (emails) you saw? If you share that list I’ll prioritize those accounts first and deliver an initial packet by Monday (2027-06-21).

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Compliance — Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

Alex / Hannah — payload attached. See below for what I pulled and a short runbook for reproducibility.

Attachments: kestrel_scim_delta_20270618.csv, rbac_mapping_kestrel_v2.xlsx

What I pulled
- SCIM delta (CSV) covering 2027-05-29 23:00 UTC through 2027-06-03 07:00 UTC. Columns: timestamp_utc, user_email, previous_group, new_group, initiated_by, scim_event_id.
- RBAC mapping (xlsx): role_name, permissions_list (token, model-deploy, config-write), default_ttl, notes.

Notes and redactions
- I redacted user.displayName fields and removed any oauth_token columns. Emails are intact (we know you need them).
- The bulk of changes on 2027-06-01 were automated service-account reconciles from an internal migration; see row notes "svc-migrate-ops" in the CSV. Manual human escalations are ~5 users, flagged with initiated_by=user-admin@redwood.ai.

Next steps
- Rishi: can you attach the SAML assertions export and a short note about MFA status as discussed? I included a column in the CSV flagged as "manual_escalation" for quick filtering.

Laura Bennett
Senior Security Engineer — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Alex — attaching the SAML extraction and a brief context note.

Attachments: saml_assertions_20270618.log

Summary of SAML artifacts
- Extracted assertions for all sessions tied to the flagged emails between 2027-05-30 00:00 UTC and 2027-06-02 23:59 UTC. Each entry includes assertion_id, audience, authn_instant, attributes (email, roles), and auth_method.
- MFA: For the five manual escalations Laura flagged, the authn_instant shows MFA=true in 4/5 cases; one was a service desk action (manual password reset + admin assignment) and is noted in the assertion comments.
- Recommendation: we can provide a short attestation statement if Kestrel needs formal wording for the SOC/SIG response; Hannah, I can draft a one-paragraph justification per user.

Happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk the packet together.

— Rishi
Principal Applied Security Engineer — Redwood Inference
